description: This header file declares utility functions and macros used by the 'bbf.config' daemon, including functions for reloading services, applying configuration changes, and making ubus calls, as well as macro definitions for memory management and logging.

methods.name: strncpyt
methods.description: Copies up to n characters from src to dst, ensuring null termination.

methods.name: bbf_config_call
methods.description: Performs a ubus call with specified parameters and a callback.

methods.name: reload_specified_services
methods.description: Reloads a specific list of services based on configuration directories and reload flags.

methods.name: reload_all_services
methods.description: Reloads all services from the specified configuration directories.

methods.name: uci_apply_changes
methods.description: Applies configuration changes via UCI in the specified directories.

methods.name: uci_config_changes
methods.description: Prepares configuration changes for UCI based on blob buffer.
